fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The MBA at the University of Sheffield is a one-year, full-time programme. Sheffield University Management School runs it. The next intake starts in September 2027. Teaching takes place in a dedicated MBA executive suite on the Sheffield campus.

The course is accredited by the Association of MBAs, EQUIS, AACSB and the Chartered Management Institute (CMI).

The university says a selection of modules is available each year. Examples include Leading People and Transforming Organisations, Global Managerial Economics, and Accounting and Corporate Finance. There are also several named challenges, including the Sheffield MBA Challenge and an AI, Analytics and Digital Technologies Challenge.

You apply what you learn to live projects with real clients, from local start-ups to global multinationals. The course also includes a 3-day study visit to Mannheim Business School and Frankfurt, and a London Career Safari.

**The most important rule for you:** you need at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience. A good degree is not enough on its own.

## Can you get in?

**Your degree.** You need a minimum 2.2 undergraduate honours degree. A 2.2 is a lower second-class honours degree. Sheffield's India entry page lists 55% as the equivalent of a 2:2 (Lower Second Class Honours).

**Your work experience.** You need at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience. The course page sets this as an entry requirement.

**Your English.** The university asks for IELTS 6.5 overall, with 6 in each component. IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is an English test. Other English qualifications are also accepted. See the [university's English language page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/english-language).

**Your interview.** Every application is reviewed. Successful applicants are invited to an online interview. Attending an interview is a requirement of the MBA admissions process.

**If you do not meet the entry rules.** The course page says that if you do not meet the entry requirements, you can study a Pre-Masters in Business, Social Sciences and Humanities at University of Sheffield International College first.

## What it costs

**Tuition.** For 2027-28 entry, the overseas tuition fee is **£37,630**. The course is one year long, so this is the fee for the whole programme. The university has a fixed fee guarantee in place for postgraduate taught overseas students.

**Application fee.** There is no application fee for postgraduate taught master's programmes.

**Tuition deposit.** After you accept an unconditional offer (an offer with no conditions left to meet), the university normally asks you to pay a deposit on your tuition fee. A deposit is an advance payment towards your tuition. Your offer letter gives the amount and the due date.

**Optional study trip.** If you join the international study trip, you pay a **£100** non-refundable deposit. Non-refundable means you do not get it back.

**Living money for the visa.** You must show that you can pay for your living costs. Sheffield is outside London, so the rate is **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. The money must have been available for **28 days in a row**. The end of that 28-day period must be within 31 days of the date you apply.

**CAS.** A Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) is issued by your course provider once you are accepted. You need it for your visa application.

**Visa fee and health surcharge.** The student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**. The Immigration Health Surcharge is **£776 for each year** of your visa.

### Worked first-year total

This is an example, not a budget.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, MBA (2027-28, overseas) | £37,630 |
| Living money: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge, one year | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £49,503** |

The sum is £37,630 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £49,503. The surcharge is £776 or more, so the total is at least that figure.

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164. That is £776 plus half of £776 (£388).

Read the rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare total costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

There are two main awards for this programme. They cannot be combined.

**Sheffield MBA Scholarship Scheme.** This gives **50%** of the tuition fee, awarded on a competitive basis. It is for the MBA only. You do not make a separate application. At the listed fee of £37,630, 50% is £18,815. It is a tuition discount, not cash.

To be considered, you must hold an unconditional or conditional offer. You must be self-funding, so sponsored students cannot apply. You must start in Autumn 2027. The university awards scholarships throughout the year.

**International Postgraduate Scholarship 2027.** This is a **£7,000** tuition fee reduction for students from selected countries. India is on the list. You do not apply for it separately. You must:

- be a full-time, self-funded student with overseas fee status
- be a permanent resident of, or have lived in, India for the last 3 years
- accept your offer by 4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027

**Only one award.** You cannot combine the 50% MBA scholarship with the £7,000 scholarship. If you are selected for more than one scholarship, the most valuable award takes precedence.

**Alumni discount.** If you already hold a Sheffield degree, you can get up to £2,500 off your tuition fees.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Item | Date |
|---|---|
| Intake | September 2027 only |
| Closing date for September 2027 entry | Friday 3 September 2027, 17:00 British Summer Time |
| Last date to apply if you need a UK student visa | Thursday 26 August 2027 |
| Accept an International Postgraduate Scholarship offer | Tuesday 6 July 2027, 4pm UK time |

The closing date is the university's date for all postgraduate taught courses starting in September 2027.

Apply early, because visa timing matters. The earliest you can apply for a visa is 6 months before your course starts. The government says a decision usually takes 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK.

## How to apply

There is no application fee. Follow these steps.

1. Check the entry rules above: a 2.2 degree, at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience, and IELTS 6.5 with 6 in each component.
2. Start your application on the university's **Postgraduate Online Application Form**, from the [MBA course page](https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/courses/2027/mba-master-business-administration-mba).
3. Upload your supporting statement. It answers four questions, with 200 words for each question.
4. Upload an up-to-date CV. You do not need references.
5. Wait for the initial review by the MBA admissions team.
6. If you are shortlisted, attend the online interview.
7. Accept your offer. If you hold an unconditional offer, pay the tuition deposit by the date in your offer letter.
8. If you need a visa, ask your course provider for your CAS and apply for the visa. See the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- The university says its MBA graduates work across a wide range of industries and job roles around the world.
- You get one-to-one support from a Careers and Employability Consultant, and you join the university's alumni network.
- After a UK course, you can apply for the Graduate visa. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026. It lasts 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. The application fee is £937.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you have a 2.2 degree or better and at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience
- you want a one-year, full-time MBA with live projects for real clients
- you are self-funding, can show £1,171 a month for 9 months, and can pay the £558 visa fee and the £776 a year health surcharge
- you want to be considered for the 50% scholarship

**Think carefully if:**

- you have less than three years of full-time postgraduate work experience
- your IELTS is below 6.5 overall, or below 6 in any component
- you are sponsored, because the 50% scholarship is only for self-funded students
- you need a visa and would apply after Thursday 26 August 2027

faq_json.q: How much is the MBA at the University of Sheffield for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For 2027-28 entry, the overseas tuition fee is £37,630. The course lasts one year, so this is the fee for the whole programme. There is no application fee.

faq_json.q: What do I need to get into the Sheffield MBA?
faq_json.a: You need a minimum 2.2 undergraduate honours degree and at least three years of full-time postgraduate work experience. You also need IELTS 6.5 overall, with 6 in each component, and an online interview if you are shortlisted.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the Sheffield MBA?
faq_json.a: The closing date for September 2027 entry is Friday 3 September 2027, 17:00 British Summer Time. If you need a student visa, the last date to apply is Thursday 26 August 2027.

faq_json.q: Do I need to apply separately for the Sheffield scholarships?
faq_json.a: The 50% Sheffield MBA Scholarship Scheme has no separate application. You must be self-funding and hold an unconditional or conditional offer. The £7,000 International Postgraduate Scholarship is automatic for India, but you must accept your offer by 4pm UK time on Tuesday 6 July 2027. You cannot combine the two.

faq_json.q: Can I stay in the UK after the MBA?
faq_json.a: You may be able to apply for the Graduate visa. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026, and 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. The application fee is £937.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the visa?
faq_json.a: If you study outside London, you must show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, which is £10,539. You must have had the money for 28 days in a row. The Immigration Health Surcharge is £776 for each year of your visa.
